svg.title: Direction augmentation reduces sensitivity, with a clean-error trade-off
svg.text: Lower rotation increments do not imply lower absolute error
Synthetic direction robustness improves, with a clean-accuracy
[E6] Dorschky; 9 healthy outer targets; fixed synthetic 10° rotations. A_S changes both source and target augmentation.
